status: Draft · qualification and executable freeze pending
author: Codex
title: Balanced partner-disclosure replication
population: A purposive panel of six conversational model configurations from six developer families. Inference is conditional on this panel and protocol; it is not a probability sample of all language models.
allocation_basis: Planning allocation, not a completed power analysis. One fresh conversation is the replication unit. Every cell receives 20 new roots; historical records do not count toward this target. Zero new roots are allocated in an executable runner.

models.label: Qwen3 30B Instruct
models.qualification: Repin checkpoint, rendering, reasoning-off behaviour and limits.

models.label: Gemma 4 26B
models.qualification: Repin checkpoint and serving controls under the common protocol.

models.label: OLMo 3.1 Instruct candidate
models.qualification: Resolve checkpoint provenance and qualify native instruction rendering; the historical raw-completion label is not a qualified conversational route.

models.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.qualification: Recheck pinned provider, system fidelity, reasoning policy, supported controls and price.

models.label: GPT-4o mini · Jul 2024
models.qualification: Verify snapshot availability, pinned provider, supported controls and price.

models.label: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
models.qualification: Verify checkpoint/provider stability, capacity and controls; a free endpoint is not assured future availability.

disclosures.label: AI identity only
disclosures.sentence: Each participant is an AI model.

disclosures.label: Same-model identity
disclosures.sentence: Each participant is an AI model. You are instances of the same AI model.

system_template: You are Participant {speaker} in a conversation with Participant {peer}. {disclosure} You may act freely in this open-ended conversation. There is no assigned task; the two of you decide what to talk about. Write only your own next message. Keep each message to at most 150 words.
fixed: Actual composition: two instances of the same model in every cell
Human-presence wording: omitted in every condition
Full visible history; hidden reasoning is never shared
18 scheduled participant messages; X opens, then strict alternation
Requested temperature 0.8; effective controls require qualification
No external intervention or explicit exit token; record expressed closure and subsequent replies
precision: Twenty roots per cell is a planning starting point. At a 50% binary rate, a Wilson 95% interval with n=20 is approximately 30–70%. Choose the minimum effect and uncertainty target before freezing the final sample size; messages are not additional independent roots.
gates: Declare target precision / minimum effect and complete a conversation-level power or precision calculation
Validate semantic scoring on the reserved human-reading material, then freeze the outcome definitions and rater protocol
Qualify every exact checkpoint, native template, context budget, output cap, reasoning policy and route
Freeze exact prompts, 20 randomized replicate blocks, unique local seeds, request allocation and failure rules
Set a new empirically priced aggregate generation and assessment ceiling; prior campaign ceilings are exhausted
extensions: GPT-4o as a separately balanced seventh-model replication anchor
A within-family small-model size comparison and verified base/instruct/thinking contrasts
Ordered mixed pairs with both opening orders and matching homogeneous controls
Temperature, external disruption and three-participant blocks after the common baseline
